title: Image tensor explorer — from a pixel to a video

checkpoints.hint: Walk rank 0 -> 4 on a real image: one pixel is a scalar, a row is a vector, a grayscale photo is a matrix, color adds a 3rd 'channels' dimension (R, G, B per pixel), and a video adds a 4th (time). Watch the array on the right grow the same way — each new dimension multiplies the numbers the chip stores.
